chapter: Arrangements, repertoire and the last band
title: Manuscripts and arrangements he wrote for his band
summary: He shows parts he wrote, buying piano copies and arranging them for every instrument, and recalls popular tunes he played, including a three-piece band that played Copenhagen.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
